scripts.preflight:chromium: node -e "require('node:fs').statfs('.',(e,s)=>{if(e)throw e;const n=Number(s.bavail)*Number(s.bsize);if(n<1073741824)throw Error('Chromium install requires 1 GiB free; found '+n);console.log('Chromium free-space preflight: '+n+' bytes available')})"
scripts.install:chromium: npm run preflight:chromium && mkdir -p .cache/ms-playwright .tmp/playwright && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=$PWD/.cache/ms-playwright TMPDIR=$PWD/.tmp/playwright playwright install chromium
scripts.test:s11: npm run preflight:chromium && mkdir -p .cache/ms-playwright .tmp/playwright && chmod 1777 .tmp/playwright && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=$PWD/.cache/ms-playwright TMPDIR=$PWD/.tmp/playwright node engine/tests/test-phase2-5-capture.mjs
